purpose: Before new features: campaigns run only from reviewed code and declarations on main, and two campaigns can never take the same repair.

authorization.grantedBy: owner (netbka), delegated to the owner's main session
authorization.text: On 2026-10-12 the owner directed: "take this as starting point and deliver till end. Delivery this work with the AIWorks environment." The starting point is docs/PROJECT_WORKSPACE_PLAN.md (PR #12), with owner decisions D1, D3, D5 (direction only) and D9 recorded in its section 8. This campaign takes wave 0 of the plan: the AIWorks stopper rule (#17), port archived Engineering Platform PR #139 (AW-005 enforcement), port archived PR #126 (duplicate repair admission, #5 scope A) and the #6 documentation carry-over. Commits are published as PRs only: the supervisor never merges or deploys, and the live runtime, its data directory, the governance checkout and the scheduled tasks are never touched. No run cap or cost ceiling (AW-002); provider limits are waited out. Provider order Claude, then Codex.

constraints: Program netbka/aiworks#14: deliver docs/PROJECT_WORKSPACE_PLAN.md through supervisor campaigns. Change only the files your task names. Other campaigns change other files at the same time: never edit their files, other agents' branches or worktrees, or campaigns/*.json.

Your assigned worktree is the only place you change files. Never touch D:/Git/aiworks/.local (live runtime, supervisor data directory, governance checkout, other worktrees) or the main checkout, and never start, stop or restart the supervisor, its scheduled tasks or the dashboard.

No production access, deployment, GitHub Actions changes, paid services, Telegram or other provider API calls, or new recurring spend. Never read .env contents, credentials or secret files. Read Engineering Platform only with read-only gh commands; never write the governance checkout or open changes in another repository: EP-side changes are proposed as text.
Follow AGENTS.md: run npm ci once in your worktree, then npm run check after changes. Report exact commands and pass/fail tallies.

Never weaken an assertion, delete or skip a test, or broaden a timeout to make the gate pass. Tests make no model, network or GitHub calls: synthetic executables and disposable git repositories, as tests/supervisor/helpers.mjs does.

Keep AW-001 to AW-007 as written. Do not enable a power whose decision is still open (GitHub-free local admission, Auto Release, Telegram delivery): design it, or build it switched off, and name the decision it waits for.

Label every claim about the running system observed, verified, planned or unknown (AGENTS.md evidence rule); merged is not deployed. Do not comment on GitHub, merge, close issues or change labels: the supervisor publishes your verified commit. Write "Refs #N", never "Closes".
Write for the owner first: plain English, short sentences, the outcome before the mechanism. Link Engineering Platform policies instead of copying them.

tasks.title: When to stop for the owner: add the stopper rule to AGENTS.md
tasks.outcome: Agents working on AIWorks stop for the owner only for owner-reserved matters, and every unjustified stop is recorded as an issue.
tasks.goal: Fix the rule gap recorded in #17 (gh issue view 17). Add a short section "When to stop for the owner" to AGENTS.md that applies Engineering Platform's rules to AIWorks, linking them instead of copying them: docs/OWNER_INTERVENTION.md and docs/DELIVERY_PRACTICES.md sections "Prove the blocker" and "Unjustified interruptions" (read with gh api, read-only). Use netbka/Dyk AGENTS.md section 4 as the model (gh api repos/netbka/Dyk/contents/AGENTS.md, read-only). It must say: ask the owner only for an owner-reserved matter (one owner-reserved issue with options, a recommendation and a default that keeps current behaviour, while other work continues; silence keeps the default), for a destructive or hard-to-reverse action not already authorized, or for access only the owner can grant after the allowed alternatives failed; never add a new blocking gate that depends on something only the owner can provide; prove a blocker before pausing; every unjustified interruption gets an issue. Name the AIWorks cases that are not owner stops: merging a PR that passed the supervisor's independent verification of its exact head (owner decision 2026-10-12, #17), declaring campaigns for an outcome the owner already authorized, provider limits, one failing tool or provider, file overlap with another task.
constraints: Change only AGENTS.md. Add the section; keep every existing rule. Where the section records the 2026-10-12 owner decision on supervisor verification as the review, say so next to the existing rule in "Changing the supervisor" with a link to #17, without removing that rule.
acceptance: The section links EP OWNER_INTERVENTION.md and DELIVERY_PRACTICES.md#unjustified-interruptions and copies no EP policy text beyond one-line summaries.

It lists the allowed owner stops, the AIWorks non-stops named in the goal, the default-and-continue rule for owner-reserved questions, the no-new-self-made-blockers rule and the issue-per-unjustified-interruption rule.
No existing rule in AGENTS.md is removed or weakened; the PR shows the diff is additive apart from the linked note on supervisor verification.

tasks.title: Enforce AW-005: start and resume only from merged code and a declaration on main
tasks.outcome: A campaign can no longer start or resume from unreviewed supervisor code or from a declaration that is not on main.
tasks.goal: Port archived Engineering Platform PR #139 to AIWorks. Read it first: gh pr view 139 --repo netbka/engineering-platform-archive --comments, and gh pr diff 139 --repo netbka/engineering-platform-archive (head e4c438d8). It added src/supervisor/provenance.mjs and enforced AW-005 in three places: cli start (the declaration must be committed unmodified as campaigns/<name>.json of the checkout the CLI runs from, whose HEAD is an ancestor of origin/main; DECLARATION_NOT_ON_MAIN or RUNTIME_NOT_MERGED, nothing stored); the controller (while its own revision is unmerged it dispatches, launches and publishes nothing and raises a B2 runtime-not-merged blocker that clears by itself once merged); and dashboard Resume (the stored declaration must canonically equal a campaigns/ file in origin/main history, else 409). Re-apply it to the current AIWorks code rather than copying it: names, paths, the governance checkout and the owner-intervention core differ. Keep no bypass flag, config key or environment variable. Update docs/SUPERVISOR.md (sections 1, 5 and 6), docs/OPERATIONS_DASHBOARD.md and docs/STATUS.md open-work item 2 to say what is now enforced in code (merged, not deployed).
constraints: Change only src/supervisor/**, src/dashboard/supervisor.mjs, tests/** and the docs named in the goal. scopeDigest and authorityDigest of existing declarations stay unchanged.
Every committed declaration in campaigns/ must still pass an identical resume through cli start from a merged runtime checkout; test it.
acceptance: start refuses a declaration that is not committed unmodified as campaigns/<name>.json at a HEAD that is an ancestor of origin/main, with DECLARATION_NOT_ON_MAIN or RUNTIME_NOT_MERGED, and stores nothing (tested with disposable git repositories).

A controller running from an unmerged revision dispatches, launches and publishes nothing, raises one B2 runtime-not-merged blocker per registered campaign, lets running operations finish, and clears the hold by itself once its revision is merged (tested).
Dashboard Resume refuses with 409 a stored declaration that never existed as a campaigns/ file in origin/main history (tested).
No CLI flag, config.json key or environment variable skips a check.
Findings recorded on archived PR #139 are fixed or listed as not applicable with a reason.
npm run check passes; the PR reports exact commands and tallies and states that nothing is deployed.

tasks.title: Refuse a second campaign that would take the same repair
tasks.outcome: A new campaign that repeats active work of another campaign is refused and told which campaign already owns it.
tasks.goal: Port archived Engineering Platform PR #126 as scope A of #5. Read gh issue view 5 --comments, gh pr view 126 --repo netbka/engineering-platform-archive --comments and gh pr diff 126 --repo netbka/engineering-platform-archive (head 141d852a). Reject duplicate active commit assignments across campaign IDs at registration, transactionally. Use exact task fingerprints for existing declarations and an optional explicit task work key for shared logical repairs. Do not serialize every task under one issue or every reader. Keep idempotent same-campaign starts and amendments, owner authorization and paused ownership; a cancelled or finished campaign releases ownership. Return the existing campaign and task as the conflict without launching a worker or consuming budget. Build on the AW-005 enforcement merged by F1-AW005 instead of duplicating it. Implement only scope A; list scopes B to F of #5 as remaining in the PR. Document the rule and the optional work key in docs/SUPERVISOR.md section 1.
constraints: Change only src/supervisor/api.mjs, src/supervisor/campaign.mjs, a new src/supervisor/work-ownership.mjs, src/supervisor/store.mjs only for an additive table, their focused tests and docs/SUPERVISOR.md.
Store changes are additive and migrate older stores idempotently. scopeDigest and authorityDigest of existing declarations stay unchanged.
acceptance: Two concurrent registrations of conflicting commit tasks admit exactly one owner (tested with two SQLite connections); the refusal names the owning campaign and task, launches nothing and consumes no budget.
Independent tasks under one issue, report tasks and readers are not serialized (tested).
Same-campaign identical start, amendment with authorization.version + 1, pause and resume keep ownership; cancellation and completion release it (tested).
Each guard test fails against the code before this change; the PR says how that was shown.
npm run check passes; the PR lists #5 scopes B to F as remaining and says Refs #5.
